title: Checkpoint 107b - Provisional TL1-TL9 Technology / Component Table Acceptance Hotfix

hotfix.cp107Failure: The unaccepted CP107 contract used one-letter PowerShell helper names that collided case-insensitively with built-in aliases.
hotfix.cp107aFailure: The CP107a shared native precheck directly accessed an optional stages property under Set-StrictMode, causing PropertyNotFoundStrict for an architecture-only definition that omitted stages.
hotfix.contractRepair: Retain descriptive helper names and normalize the CP107b architecture definition with an explicit empty stages array.
hotfix.precheckHardening: Read optional checkpoint-definition and stage properties through PSObject.Properties so missing optional fields are safe under Set-StrictMode; retain alias-collision rejection.
